entries.title: Psalms 86:1
segments: ¶<<A Prayer of David.>> Bow down thine ear, O LORD, hear me: for I [am] poor and needy. {A Prayer...: or, A Prayer, being a Psalm of David}

words.text: . {A Prayer...: or, A Prayer, being a Psalm of David}

entries.title: Psalms 86:2
segments: Preserve my soul; for I [am] holy: O thou my God, save thy servant that trusteth in thee. {holy: or, one whom thou favourest}

words.text: in thee. {holy: or, one whom thou favourest}

entries.title: Psalms 86:3
segments: Be merciful unto me, O Lord: for I cry unto thee daily. {daily: or, all the day}

entries.title: Psalms 86:4
segments: Rejoice the soul of thy servant: for unto thee, O Lord, do I lift up my soul.

entries.title: Psalms 86:5
segments: For thou, Lord, [art] good, and ready to forgive; and plenteous in mercy unto all them that call upon thee.

entries.title: Psalms 86:6
segments: Give ear, O LORD, unto my prayer; and attend to the voice of my supplications.

entries.title: Psalms 86:7
segments: In the day of my trouble I will call upon thee: for thou wilt answer me.

words.text: upon thee: for thou wilt answer

entries.title: Psalms 86:8
segments: ¶Among the gods [there is] none like unto thee, O Lord; neither [are there any works] like unto thy works.

words.text: [there is] none like unto thee, O Lord
; neither [are there any works] like unto thy works

entries.title: Psalms 86:9
segments: All nations whom thou hast made shall come and worship before thee, O Lord; and shall glorify thy name.

entries.title: Psalms 86:10
segments: For thou [art] great, and doest wondrous things: thou [art] God alone.

entries.title: Psalms 86:11
segments: Teach me thy way, O LORD; I will walk in thy truth: unite my heart to fear thy name.

entries.title: Psalms 86:12
segments: I will praise thee, O Lord my God, with all my heart: and I will glorify thy name for evermore.

entries.title: Psalms 86:13
segments: For great [is] thy mercy toward me: and thou hast delivered my soul from the lowest hell. {hell: or, grave}

words.text: toward me: and thou hast delivered

entries.title: Psalms 86:14
segments: O God, the proud are risen against me, and the assemblies of violent [men] have sought after my soul; and have not set thee before them. {violent: Heb. terrible}

entries.title: Psalms 86:15
segments: But thou, O Lord, [art] a God full of compassion, and gracious, longsuffering, and plenteous in mercy and truth.

entries.title: Psalms 86:16
segments: O turn unto me, and have mercy upon me; give thy strength unto thy servant, and save the son of thine handmaid.

entries.title: Psalms 86:17
segments: Shew me a token for good; that they which hate me may see [it], and be ashamed: because thou, LORD, hast holpen me, and comforted me.
